phases.title: Console log and crash handling

phases.note: The game's log output is captured from the emulator and shown in the editor console with the same filters as editor logs. If the emulator crashes or the game hangs, the editor reports it, saves the last log, and offers to relaunch with the emulator's debugger open.

topics.label: window reparenting
